description: Labelled candidate pairs for the co-evidential (duplicate-claim) judge (phase 2). Every pair is one the production shortlist proposes: two ACTIVE, truth-apt particles sharing a Subject with embedding cosine at or above links_suggest.candidate_threshold (0.92), as suggest_co_evidential(mode=REPORT) enumerates them.
provenance: Drawn read-only on 2026-10-11 from a backup copy of the owner's dogfood store (5,291 candidate pairs). Excluded before sampling: pairs whose normalised texts are identical (Tier A exact duplicates, merged without a judge), pairs naming an internal decision-record id, and pairs carrying a home path, a session identifier or an e-mail address. 22 pairs were then drawn per 0.01 cosine band from 0.92 to 1.00 (seed 959), 176 in all. Particle ids are the store's; particle content never changes after creation.
labelled_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (the authoring session), reading each pair against the judge's own instruction, before any classifier or hosted judge was run on the set.

label_meaning.paraphrase: Both claims assert the same underlying fact; wording, formatting, or an incidental qualifier that changes no truth condition differs.
label_meaning.distinct: The claims assert different facts (a different PR number, version, price, test, cause, or object).
label_meaning.subsumes: One claim asserts the other's fact plus a further substantive fact, or the two enumerate overlapping but unequal sets. The judge instruction does not decide these, so they are reported apart and left out of the binary scores.
